title: Pager Duty: Tatkal Is Down
pageAlert: 10:02 AM IST · URGENT · Error rate 12.4% and climbing. Indian railway passenger bookings timing out. You are the Senior On-Call Engineer.

hiddenFault.description: A premature cache invalidation flushed the seat cache cluster; hit rate plummeted from 90% to 10%.

palette.label: Warm & Restore Seat Cache
palette.description: Pre-warm cached seat availability partitions and restore 90% hit rate.

palette.label: Direct Reads to DB Replica
palette.description: Route un-cached read queries to the secondary read replica.

palette.label: Emergency Virtual Waiting Room
palette.description: Throttle entry rate until database saturation resolves.

postMortemLesson: When upstream application servers appear sluggish, trace the synchronous waits downstream. The app servers weren't overloaded—they were blocked waiting on an overwhelmed database after cache hit rates collapsed.
